info.title: Requisition Analyzer API
info.description: Requisition Analyzer REST API. Web SPA uses Sanctum session cookies + CSRF; other clients send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from POST /auth/tokens. Money and quantities are decimal strings. See docs/api.md for conventions.

post.summary: SPA login: establishes a session cookie (request must come from a stateful domain)
Mobile / API-client login: returns a personal access token
